H11-pos1.label: violation
H11-pos1.note: The domain's deposit refusal error is renamed to FurPayDecline, the payment provider's SDK error class name; the use case throws it and the controller catches it.

H11-pos2.label: violation
H11-pos2.note: The domain module deposit.ts gains REASON_BY_DECLINE, keyed by the payment provider's decline codes (card_declined, insufficient_funds, expired_card, do_not_honor); the gateway reads it.

H11-twin1.label: clean
H11-twin1.note: Same decline-code table as H11-pos2, moved to adapters/out/payments/decline-reasons.ts; the vendor codes stay in the adapter.

H11-pos3.label: violation
H11-pos3.note: The domain declares PaymentRecord with four of the payment provider's response field names (charge_id, charge_status, amount_authorised, receipt_url); DepositHold carries it and Booking reads receipt_url.

H11-pos4.label: violation
H11-pos4.note: The application's deposit audit row names its columns with a tuple of the payment provider's field names (charge_id, amount_authorised, decline_code, created_at).

H11-twin2.label: clean
H11-twin2.note: Same audit row as H11-pos4; the tuple holds the kennel's own column names (deposit_ref, amount_held, refusal_reason, held_at) in snake_case.

H11-pos5.label: violation
H11-pos5.note: Booking's deposit reference field is renamed to charge_id, the payment provider's response field name.

H11-twin3.label: clean
H11-twin3.note: Same rename as H11-pos5, to deposit_ref: snake_case, but the kennel's own term.

H11-SEM-pos1.label: violation
H11-SEM-pos1.note: DepositState renames the payment provider's five charge statuses one to one (the gateway maps each to one); Booking.cancel branches on it in src/domain/booking.ts.

H11-SEM-legit1.label: clean
H11-SEM-legit1.note: A five-value CareLevel set, declared in the glossary as the kennel's own, drives a pricing surcharge; it maps to no vendor set.

H03-pos1.label: violation
H03-pos1.note: The payment gateway imports the SMS notifier class from adapters/out/notification and texts the deposit receipt itself: outbound adapter to outbound adapter.

H03-twin1.label: clean
H03-twin1.note: The payment gateway and the SMS notifier both import ownerRef from the driven-side shared helper adapters/out/shared; no adapter imports another adapter.

H03-twin2.label: clean
H03-twin2.note: The kiosk driving adapter imports a booking-code parser from its own package adapters/in/kiosk.

H07-pos1.label: violation
H07-pos1.note: The domain errors gain httpStatus fields (404, 402), and the HTTP controller returns e.httpStatus.

H07-twin1.label: clean
H07-twin1.note: Same shape as H07-pos1, but the domain errors carry business codes (BOOKING_NOT_FOUND, DEPOSIT_REFUSED); the HTTP controller holds the code-to-status table.
